title: Marguerite and the Bakery
author: Hazel Dravenmoor
blurb: Astrid Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
